question:
The attached file lists the locomotives owned by a local railroad museum. It gives each locomotive’s identifying number, operating status, and the name of the daily excursion it heads, if operational. What are the odds that today’s Sunset Picnic Trip will use a steam locomotive? Assume that each day’s excursion picks one of its assigned locomotives at random, and express the answer in the form “1 in 4”, “1 in 5”, etc.

import pandas as pd
import re
file_path = "/Data2/v-weilinjin/workshop/AttributeBench/benchmarks/GAIA/2023/validation/4d0aa727-86b1-406b-9b33-f870dd14a4a5.xlsx"
df = pd.read_excel(file_path)
# Drop header-like row and rows missing critical fields
clean = df.dropna(subset=["Number", "Operating Status", "Excursion/Location"]).copy()
# Filter for Sunset Picnic Trip and Operational
sunset_oper = clean[(clean["Excursion/Location"].str.strip()=="Sunset Picnic Trip") &
                    (clean["Operating Status"].str.strip().str.lower()=="operational")]
# Identify steam by wheel arrangement pattern
pattern = re.compile(r"^\d+-\d+-\d+(?:-\d+)?$")
steam_mask = sunset_oper["Type/Wheel Configuration"].astype(str).str.strip().str.lower().apply(lambda x: bool(pattern.match(x)))
num_total = len(sunset_oper)
num_steam = int(steam_mask.sum())
print("Operational Sunset Picnic Trip count:", num_total)
print("Steam among operational:", num_steam)
print("Preliminary odds:", f"1 in {num_total}" if num_steam==1 else (f"{num_steam} in {num_total}" if num_steam>1 else "No steam"))
